title: Old Whittington Halifax Memorial
location_name: St Bartholomew's Church, Old Whittington, Derbyshire
crew_summary: Crew — details not recorded in source
memorial_details: Stained-glass window to F/S D. Crofton-Smith, KIA 13 May 1943, in St Bartholomew's Church, Old Whittington, Derbyshire.
narrative: Halifax DT645 of 51 Squadron, coded MH-B, departed Snaith at 2332 on 12 May 1943 for Duisburg. The aircraft was intercepted at 6000m by Oberleutnant Lothar Linke of 12/NJG1 and shot down at 0202, his 25th claim. Flight Sergeant D. Crofton-Smith, KIA 13 May 1943, is commemorated in the stained-glass window at St Bartholomew's Church, Old Whittington.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Oblt Lothar Linke (12/NJG1), his 25th claim
